principle: Helping one settlement should make that settlement trust the player enough to reveal better work, better local knowledge, and better utility rewards without turning the village into a grind hub.

bountiful_6_0_4_facts.trust_source: board-local completed bounty count / Bountiful reputation
bountiful_6_0_4_facts.multiplayer_semantics: shared settlement trust because Bountiful derives board level from the sum of all players' completions at that board
bountiful_6_0_4_facts.objective_rep_required_native_bug_or_gap: Bountiful 6.0.4 applies repRequired to reward selection but not objective selection; CozyCrazyQuests runtime V1 filters objective entries by repRequired too
bountiful_6_0_4_facts.reason_for_no_accepted_timer: In 6.0.4 the timer starts when the bounty is generated on the board, not when the player takes it, so expedition jobs can arrive already partly expired. CozyCrazyCraft prefers commitment without arbitrary real-time pressure.

board_population.reason: Five to seven choices reads as a real village notice board without becoming a quest-list wall.

rotation.intent: roughly one small board change every two real minutes; an exhausted player-facing board begins offering fresh work promptly without visibly full-rerolling while the player reads it
rotation.abandoned_bounty_behavior: player may discard/compost unwanted papers; later authored UI can add an explicit abandon action

radiant_reward_policy.ordinary_public_notices: simple village payment in emeralds; no generic bread or cooked-food lottery
radiant_reward_policy.experience: Bountiful already grants a small XP bonus when a bounty is redeemed; keep this modest rather than turning routine notices into XP farming
radiant_reward_policy.signature_items: reserve weapons, equipment, maps, pets, travel tools, temperature gear, enchanted/quality gear, and other memorable rewards for authored or trust-gated contracts

unlocks: first local-adventure leads when a sane target exists
